name: app.suprsend.notification.NotificationRedirectionActivity
description: The SuprSend Android SDK opens this Activity when someone taps one of its push notifications. It records the tap and opens the notification's link, or opens the app if the notification has no link.
disableEffect: Tapping a SuprSend notification will no longer open its destination or bring the app to the foreground, and SuprSend will not receive the tap event.
